## What I changed

I kept the change small and cohesive across four files, adding behaviour as tiny units rather than growing any existing method or class:

2. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `deriveHouseholdId` now just delegates to `Household.id(...)` (dropped the old last-name+address UUID logic and its now-unused imports). One-line body, so owners with the same last name and postcode report the same `householdId` automatically.

3. **`rest/advice/OwnerHouseholdDuplicateAdvice.java` (new)** — a focused `@Before` aspect on `addOwner`: if the new owner's `Household.id` already belongs to an existing owner, it rejects with **409**, *unless* `sharesHousehold` is set — in which case the owner is created as a declared member (bypass only, no more link-creation).

Removing the advice leaves `possibleDuplicate` at its `false` default, matching the spec.
